definitions:
CREATE INDEX ix_session_message_search_content_fts ON public.session_message_search USING gin ((
CASE
    WHEN (char_length(content) <= 18000) THEN to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, content)
    ELSE to_tsvector('simple'::regconfig, ''::text)
END))
CREATE INDEX ix_session_message_search_content_trgm ON public.session_message_search USING gin (content gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX ix_session_message_search_generation ON public.session_message_search USING btree (generation_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_session_message_search_user ON public.session_message_search USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pk_session_message_search ON public.session_message_search USING btree (session_id, content_revision, "position", chunk_index)

INSERT INTO session_message_search (user_id, session_id, generation_id, content_revision, position, chunk_index, role, content) SELECT $1::UUID AS anon_1, $2::UUID AS anon_2, $3::UUID AS anon_3, $4::VARCHAR AS anon_4, anon_5.position, anon_5.chunk_index, anon_5.role, anon_5.content
